name: PayPilot-Zapier-Integration
description: Zapier AI Actions and MCP integration specification for PayPilot Agentic Commerce.

actions.name: Order Completed Trigger
actions.description: Fires when a customer successfully captures a PayPal payment. Creates invoices in QuickBooks, logs transaction rows in Google Sheets, and sends customer receipt via Gmail.

actions.name: Refund Processed Alert
actions.description: Fires when a PayPal refund is initiated or captured, alerting merchant team in Slack and updating CRM.

actions.name: Trigger Agent Commerce Action
actions.description: Allows external connected apps (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce) to trigger automated agent workflows.
